name: Blur Statement Hero
description: A studio statement hero on grainy true black: a huge, tightly tracked sentence whose client name blurs and rolls while its slot springs to fit.

props.name: status
props.description: Mono line, top right, after a small dot.

props.name: nouns
props.description: Names that take turns in the sentence, with a short note shown beside the counter. The first one is the static name with reduced motion.

props.name: tail
props.description: Words after the name, set at 38% white. A "\n" breaks the line on wide containers so nothing re-wraps while the slot springs.

props.name: primary
props.description: White pill button with an arrow that nudges 2px on hover.

props.name: interval
props.description: How long each name holds, in ms.

props.name: theme
props.description: Grainy true black, or warm-white paper (#f4f3ef) with black ink.
